plans.idea: Classic banner reading order, tightened: brand lockup at the far left, bottle right beside the headline block so product and message read as one group, and a moderately sized CTA anchored right, with no dead gap before it.

Product-led: the bottle opens the strip at the left edge with the headline right beside it, and the brand sign-off (logo, then Shop Now) sits as one tight right-hand group, so the eye moves from product to message to brand to action.

Headline-first: the copy leads at the left as the dominant element, the bottle sits in the centre as a visual pivot, Shop Now follows straight after it, and the Solstice lockup closes the strip at the right like a brand signature.
